title: Move option
description: One selectable move offered to the model. The id is content-derived and re-resolved against a fresh enumeration on every make_move.

id.description: Semantic move key, e.g. build|stafford|0|cotton, network|a~b, develop|coal,iron, sell|7, or the bare words loan, scout, pass, confirmTurn. Excludes the card spent, so it survives hand changes. Unique within one enumeration by construction.

kind.description: The move's tag, mirroring legal-move.kind. Present so the model can group options without parsing the id.

label.description: Human-readable rendering, e.g. "Build cotton L1 in Stafford (slot 0)". This is what the model actually reasons over.

move.description: The enumerated move in full, so nothing is hidden behind the label.
